tip.title: Learning Goal

sections.title: Topic Vocabulary: Places & Directions
sections.description: Learn each item as a complete meaning-and-use unit.

cards.definition: a place where people borrow books
in the middle of two things

tip.title: Vocabulary Strategy
tip.text: Say each item aloud, notice its common partners and use it in a personal sentence.

sections.title: Grammar for Clear Communication
sections.description: Study the form, meaning and use before completing the skills tasks.

points.title: There is / There are
points.function: there is + singular; there are + plural
examples: There is a bank near here.

points.title: Place prepositions
examples: The pharmacy is opposite the bank.
The café is between the shops.

tip.title: Accuracy Tip
tip.text: Choose grammar from the meaning you need, then check the verb form and subject.

sections.title: Listening: Places & Directions
sections.description: Listen once for gist and again for detail.

audio.transcript: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here? Yes. Go straight along King Street and turn left at the library. There is a small supermarket on the corner. The pharmacy is next to it, opposite the bank. It takes about five minutes to walk there. Thank you. You're welcome.

gistQuestions.explanation: The complete recording supports this main idea.

detailQuestions.prompt: Where should the visitor turn left?
detailQuestions.explanation: This detail is stated in the recording. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Listening Strategy
tip.text: Use the first listen for context and the second listen to confirm exact details.

sections.title: Reading: Places & Directions
sections.description: Complete the text, then answer the comprehension question.

passage.title: Places & Directions
parts: the park. There is a café
the library. To reach the bank, go
and turn right at the traffic lights.

tip.title: Reading Strategy
tip.text: Read around each gap and check both meaning and grammar before choosing.

sections.title: Speaking: Places & Directions
sections.description: Prepare briefly, record your response and review it.
questions: What places are near your home?
sections.sampleAnswer: There is a supermarket near my home. It is opposite a small park and next to a pharmacy. To get there, go straight along my street and turn right at the bank.
prompts: Answer every part of the prompt.

tip.title: Speaking Tip
tip.text: Organise your answer into a clear beginning, two details and a short ending.

sections.title: Writing: Places & Directions
sections.description: Write 35-55 words using this module's language.

prompt.situation: Write directions from your home to a nearby place.
prompt.referenceAnswer: There is a supermarket near my home. It is opposite a small park and next to a pharmacy. To get there, go straight along my street and turn right at the bank.

tip.title: Writing Checklist
tip.text: Check task coverage, verb forms, vocabulary choice, spelling and word count.

sections.title: Module Checkpoint
sections.description: Check the key grammar and vocabulary before moving on.

questions.prompt: There ___ two cafés near the station.
questions.explanation: This is the target grammar form from the module.

tip.title: Progress
tip.text: Review any incorrect answer, then record a final speaking response.
